mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an emergency monetary policy response to a severe economic contraction, which typically precedes a sharp rebound in equity valuations due to liquidity injection and risk-on sentiment over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Federal funds rate was 0.16% as of 2008-12-01
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a policy response and reduces equity risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 7.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in residential construction starts below 600,000 units, combined with a concurrent drop in consumer spending (RSAFS), signals a deepening housing and consumption crisis, which triggers aggressive fiscal and monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances, or the interaction effect (joint signal) does not improve predictive power over individual proxies (IC difference < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a severe supply-side shock, which typically leads to inflationary pressures and policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (as proxied by RSAFS) below 325,000 million dollars, combined with a concurrent drop in housing starts, signals a collapse in aggregate demand, which leads to a policy response and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect does not improve predictive power (IC difference < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a labor market breakdown, which triggers policy intervention and risk-on sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines in 2 consecutive months and UNRATE increases in same period
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect does not improve predictive power (IC difference < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% combined with a rising CPIAUCSL above 213.0 indicates stagflationary pressures, which leads to aggressive monetary easing and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances, or the interaction effect does not improve predictive power (IC difference < 0.02).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 11700 billion dollars, combined with a sharp drop in industrial production, signals a deep recession, which triggers fiscal stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in all instances, or the interaction effect does not improve predictive power (IC difference < 0.02).
